fields.label: Tines tenant host
fields.description: Tenant FQDN only, no scheme or path -- e.g. acme.tines.com. Crogl adds https:// and the /api/v1 paths. Self-hosted tenants use their own FQDN here.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Tines API key, created under Settings -> Access & security -> API keys. Injected server-side as the Authorization: Bearer header. Use a Team key (role-based access to one team) or a Service key; never a Tenant owner key, which carries full owner access. This connector exposes no write actions, so it needs no permission beyond reading stories. See https://www.tines.com/stories/docs/api/authentication/

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (for self-signed certs).
